customer: I work nights as a nurse and I'm trying to sort out selling my compact sedan to you without paying for insurance I don't need. My insurer keeps asking when I want to cancel and I honestly have no idea what the right answer is. I'm in Georgia, if that matters, and I just want a straight answer so I can stop dealing with this between shifts.
agent: I'm sorry this has been a hassle on top of your night shifts. Per our article "When to cancel your insurance," please keep your sedan insured until the sale is complete and the car is in our hands, including on the day of a home pickup, and cancel your policy or remove the car from it only after you sign the paperwork. Your insurer can tell you whether you'll get a refund for the unused part of your premium. Before you hand the car over, please also remove any toll tags and personal data like garage codes and paired phones.
